title: Extraction benchmark
purpose: Show the quantitative tradeoff behind the extraction choice.
takeaway: Conservative DOM extraction retained 126 of 129 required anchors, with substantially higher measured boilerplate leakage.

bullets: Held-out HTML evaluation: 32 evaluable pages, 129 required anchors, 50 unwanted anchors.
Readability retained 86.0% with 22.0% leakage; Trafilatura retained 77.5% with 22.0% leakage.

speaker_notes: State that anchor-based retention and leakage are not whole-document recall and precision.
open_questions: Choose between a direct report capture and a native editable chart.
